four_candidate_table.gate2_verdict: COUNTS_ONLY — Gate 2 geometry can be measured, but Gate 1 failed so these matches are not eligible as independent-reference overlap
blockers: All 156,099 Harvey records in the FEMA Historical Geospatial Damage Assessment Database have ASMT_TYPE=MOD (modeled) and DMG_TYPE=FL (flood). The service description states assessments were conducted 'either using high-resolution imagery or by means of geospatial modeling.' IMG_DATE is null for every Harvey record. This is not a field or UAV independent reference, so it cannot satisfy Gate 1 as frozen in the eval protocol (conflict ground truth must come from a non-satellite field/UAV source). Label tallies and matcher counts below are reported for coverage completeness only.
